Summarization
The global electric vehicle market has seen unprecedented growth over the past five years. 
Major automakers including Tesla, Ford, and Volkswagen have committed billions to EV development. 
Battery costs have dropped by 89% since 2010, making EVs increasingly affordable. 
Governments worldwide are offering subsidies and planning to ban combustion engines by 2035.
